name: Spinops
sum: Spinops is a medium-sized centrosaurine from the Oldman Formation of Alberta, known from a partial parietal bone.
wsnote: Estimates in the cited Wikipedia revision.
holotype: NHMUK PV R 16307, a partial parietal bone with most of the midline bar — Oldman Formation, Alberta.
material: Further material referred to the genus.
biology: Known from frill material; no behavioural data.
author: Farke et al. 2011
